usage: 南非 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country South Africa.
It is typically followed by measure words or classifiers when counting or specifying cities, regions, or people from South Africa.
In conversation, 南非 can be used as both subject and object depending on the sentence structure.
It can be combined with verbs like 去 (go), 嚟 (come), or 係 (be) to talk about traveling to, coming from, or being located in South Africa.
When mentioning 南非, it is common to talk about its culture, geography, or people.
